vsn:408ab676bf601dc9.source: If you're not willing to negotiate, I *am* prepared to defend myself.
vsn:408ab676bf601dc9.translation: 要是你不肯谈，我*也*已经做好自卫的准备了。

vsn:2b8f5ab970c43a0d.source: But first, looks like you've got some stolen cosmo-gear...
vsn:2b8f5ab970c43a0d.translation: 不过先等等，看来你这里有偷来的宇宙装备……

vsn:1e25dcb57a403789.source: Lookee what we have here... my lighttazer!
vsn:1e25dcb57a403789.translation: 瞧瞧，这是什么……我的光刃电击器！

vsn:c43c5f565e06d0c8.source: Tutone's got an eco-crisis to resolve, and I've got a little bro to find!
vsn:c43c5f565e06d0c8.translation: 图托恩的生态危机等着解决，我还得找到弟弟！

vsn:d0bb8d97f63d8195.source: Well well, looks like you're awake.

vsn:b07c8ad017bcf6ee.source: I'm not here to hurt you, big guy. I just want a little information.
vsn:b07c8ad017bcf6ee.translation: 我不是来伤害你的，大块头。我只是想打听点消息。

vsn:66f7f54f424dae18.source: First things first, have you seen any other cosmo-agents down in this-
vsn:66f7f54f424dae18.translation: 先说正事，你有没有在这下面见过其他宇宙特工——

vsn:5e978ea7565277c1.source: Heeey! What are you freaking out about? I just wanted to talk!
vsn:5e978ea7565277c1.translation: 喂——！你慌什么？我只是想聊聊！

vsn:a2efba0262349764.source: Gah!! You get back here! I'm not done with you yet!
vsn:a2efba0262349764.translation: 啊！！给我回来！我还没跟你说完呢！

vsn:39679a604de85598.source: Well now, you tried to set up an ambush didn't you? See what happens?
vsn:39679a604de85598.translation: 瞧瞧，你刚才是想设埋伏，对不对？这下知道后果了吧？

vsn:a4b06d7af2435d0f.source: Didn't mean to bonk you so hard... but if it's a fight you want, I'll bring it!
vsn:a4b06d7af2435d0f.translation: 我也没想敲你那么重……不过你要想打，我就奉陪！

vsn:1c1cac4eab746a0e.source: I didn't become one of the most elite agents with sloppy tazer-play!
vsn:1c1cac4eab746a0e.translation: 我能成为最精锐的特工之一，可不是靠乱挥电击器！

vsn:f2062c918559f326.source: And no belligerent lizard is gonna stop me from saving this planet!
vsn:f2062c918559f326.translation: 好斗的蜥蜴可别想阻止我拯救这颗星球！

vsn:1bda7588dadabb44.source: So, ready to start talking yet? I'm a Cosmobreeder, and I'm here to help!
vsn:1bda7588dadabb44.translation: 怎么样，现在肯说话了吗？我是宇宙育种者，是来帮忙的！

vsn:a277fefc0e7fcb4a.source: We're the galaxy-wide experts in fauna management.
vsn:a277fefc0e7fcb4a.translation: 我们是全银河动物管理方面的专家。

vsn:0f0e972ec4372e48.source: Our noble mission: to restore and nurture even the most ruined planets!
vsn:0f0e972ec4372e48.translation: 我们崇高的使命，就是让再破败的星球也能恢复生机、茁壮成长！

vsn:4b742bf0e650f242.source: No bio-wasteland or terra-forming disaster is too far gone...
vsn:4b742bf0e650f242.translation: 不管是生态荒原，还是星球改造灾难，都还有救……

vsn:ac8f111fea715f4f.source: When you see the miracles that we can work, I'm sure you'll regret fighting!
vsn:ac8f111fea715f4f.translation: 等你见识到我们创造的奇迹，一定会后悔跟我打架！

vsn:00748022707d2e31.source: Even the most violent species eventually come to love their wise...
vsn:00748022707d2e31.translation: 就算是最凶暴的物种，最终也会爱上他们睿智的……

vsn:a1c54f68285a2db2.translation: ……英勇的、悉心照料他们的宇宙育种者！

vsn:4a56d49b6059eb25.source: W-woah big guy! I was just explaining how I'm super helpful!
vsn:4a56d49b6059eb25.translation: 哇、哇哦，大块头！我只是在解释我有多能帮上忙！

vsn:90e0cef378959f3d.source: You don't have to go scrambling off!
vsn:90e0cef378959f3d.translation: 用不着这么慌慌张张地跑掉吧！

vsn:268140c6b7f44731.source: ...just let me strap this bracer on...

vsn:bdd10149d5eee6d1.source: There! Looks like you've had enough!
vsn:bdd10149d5eee6d1.translation: 好了！看来你已经吃够苦头了！

vsn:bd8f1836adac5e62.source: You should be proud, not many creatures can hold their own against an
vsn:bd8f1836adac5e62.translation: 你该感到自豪，没多少生物能在PPP的精英特工手下

vsn:7089edb7f7db44f4.source: elite agent of the PPP for even a few minutes!

vsn:d148ff4cf882a3a1.source: My last sharp counter must have really stung for you to-
vsn:d148ff4cf882a3a1.translation: 我最后那记凌厉的反击，肯定把你打疼了才会——

vsn:e6e099f166f4716e.translation: [“反击”，我的朋友？你一定是在说笑。]

vsn:e5cbe6fdf1a40243.source: [As a father, I have much experience in play-fighting with pups such as yourself.]
vsn:e5cbe6fdf1a40243.translation: [身为父亲，我可没少陪你这样的小崽子打闹。]

vsn:e849afee2ae10328.source: [My true powers are far beyond anything you can comprehend!]
vsn:e849afee2ae10328.translation: [我真正的力量，远远超出你的理解！]

vsn:328680d9d02653b8.source: [...but for now, you may experience a mere taste of my PSY powers!!!]
vsn:328680d9d02653b8.translation: [……不过现在，你可以先尝尝我精神力量的一点皮毛！！！]

vsn:517b1e0cd60f3bf1.source: [Now, perhaps in order to get you accustomed to this new PSY-forced form]
vsn:517b1e0cd60f3bf1.translation: [现在，为了让你适应这个被精神力强制变成的新形态，]

vsn:0a9c4e5afccfdf63.source: [you can demonstrate some of these amazing "counters" that you believe you have?]
vsn:0a9c4e5afccfdf63.translation: [不如展示一下你自以为会的那些精彩“反击”？]

vsn:4396da4e75d5214d.source: That was... not fair at all...

vsn:8b4b621ff81bfaf9.source: ...I hadn't... had any training... in quadrupedal...

vsn:d897990252ced396.source: ...n-now where was that Vitamin... I saw...
vsn:d897990252ced396.translation: ……我、我看到的那颗维生素……在哪儿来着……

vsn:cdc24b20ec1db305.source: ...gee Dad, did you have to be so rough on that girl?
vsn:cdc24b20ec1db305.translation: ……哎，爸爸，你非得对那个姑娘下这么重的手吗？

vsn:1635cfaea5a0c270.source: I've never seen you fight with someone like that before!
vsn:1635cfaea5a0c270.translation: 我以前从没见过你那样跟谁打过！

vsn:acd083304cc04cc2.source: My son, that "girl" was able to accept and master our ESPer powers
vsn:acd083304cc04cc2.translation: 儿子，那个“姑娘”竟能接受并掌握我们超能力者的力量，

vsn:f1dc9fff741762f2.source: in the span of a single battle.
vsn:f1dc9fff741762f2.translation: 只用了一场战斗的时间。

vsn:2dde143a3d210429.source: She very well may be the one to save this world from the sorry state it's in.
vsn:2dde143a3d210429.translation: 她很可能就是能把这个世界从困境中拯救出来的人。

vsn:087bd03f2da0d5e0.source: Wow, Dad! I thought you didn't believe in the rumors of "Cosmobreeder" heroes!
vsn:087bd03f2da0d5e0.translation: 哇，爸爸！我还以为你不相信“宇宙育种者”英雄的传闻呢！

vsn:6357cf2ab72d1974.source: ...this one is different, son. They may indeed be a true hero...
vsn:6357cf2ab72d1974.translation: ……这一个不一样，儿子。这位或许真的是英雄……

vsn:e1213a9c1cca1554.source: Aww! What an adorable little guy...!

vsn:8d76d16022bbe477.source: Why would such a sweet puppy try to rough me up? Huh?
vsn:8d76d16022bbe477.translation: 这么乖的小狗，为什么要来揍我呢？嗯？

vsn:3e3f292ab26b684a.source: You know, there's some really dangerous creatures down in this old depot.
vsn:3e3f292ab26b684a.translation: 你知道吗，这座旧仓库下面可是有些很危险的生物。

vsn:e9e38dfe7126606e.source: It's not a good idea for a pup like you to run around trying to play-fight!
vsn:e9e38dfe7126606e.translation: 你这样的小狗，到处找人打闹可不是个好主意！

vsn:f710e3908c629d8a.source: But you don't understand a word I'm sayin' do ya, cutie?
vsn:f710e3908c629d8a.translation: 不过你听不懂我说的话，对不对，小可爱？

vsn:f1ce072b8e02bd13.source: I can tell you're itching to go run and play more, so I won't stop you!
vsn:f1ce072b8e02bd13.translation: 看得出来，你还迫不及待地想去跑跑玩玩，那我就不拦你了！

vsn:d9c81372c58d0db0.source: After all, you've made it this far... for all I know, you've got a mama down here.
vsn:d9c81372c58d0db0.translation: 毕竟你都能走到这里了……说不定你妈妈就在下面呢。

vsn:cfe2380baa41c7d6.source: There you go, run along cutie!

vsn:78752cd269b4c266.source: If you do get into trouble, just give a bark and I'll come dashing in to save ya!
vsn:78752cd269b4c266.translation: 要是遇到麻烦，就叫一声，我会冲过来救你的！

vsn:ee8d1531aaf1cead.source: Huh?! What are you digging up now?

vsn:178460480cc1c236.source: Do you think there's something fun down there, or...
vsn:178460480cc1c236.translation: 你觉得下面有什么好玩的，还是……

vsn:521b0ce7d637b01c.source: Oh wow, a Level 1 Keycard! Is this for me?
vsn:521b0ce7d637b01c.translation: 哦，哇，1级门卡！这是给我的？

vsn:47f593a7521fb4f9.source: This is actually really helpful to my mission, cutie.
vsn:47f593a7521fb4f9.translation: 这真的能帮上我的任务，小可爱。

vsn:ebcb059d53a912e7.source: You might not know it, but you're really helping out your planet!
vsn:ebcb059d53a912e7.translation: 你也许不知道，可你真的在帮助自己的星球！

vsn:d6e254a585be1705.translation: [星历XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [5555星系，图托恩星] [磁鞘进入点]

vsn:903e1931792abf4e.source: ...entry successful, en route to descend at 40N, 74W in T-minus XXXX unisecs.
vsn:903e1931792abf4e.translation: ……成功进入，正前往40N、74W下降点，距下降还有XXXX标准秒。

vsn:7c8c17f83c5b2bd2.source: It's sad that your brother Yiffai's first deployment ended up this way
vsn:7c8c17f83c5b2bd2.translation: 真遗憾，你弟弟伊法伊的首次任务竟会变成这样，

vsn:ad9c16374c4f1687.source: You know the drill. Tutone is having a mass exodus of fauna
vsn:ad9c16374c4f1687.translation: 流程你都清楚。图托恩正在发生动物大规模外逃，

vsn:ea4ab330b4d230ca.source: and your job is to find out why!
vsn:ea4ab330b4d230ca.translation: 你的任务就是查明原因！

vsn:8c6c6d4c6cdaec1a.source: On top of that, you should also look for your missing fellow agents.
vsn:8c6c6d4c6cdaec1a.translation: 除此之外，你还得寻找失踪的特工同伴。

vsn:101fb9ba2d5bd05b.source: Oh? What's this? Another little spacebug entering my domain?
vsn:101fb9ba2d5bd05b.translation: 哦？这是什么？又一只小太空虫闯进了我的领地？

vsn:3ee236fbce099d85.source: Some big haired punk and her floozies shooting me down...
vsn:3ee236fbce099d85.translation: 居然被一个顶着大蓬头发的小混混和她那帮轻浮跟班打下来了……

vsn:c6168feb3e79aeb3.source: Maybe next time we can just talk it out instead of fighting, huh?
vsn:c6168feb3e79aeb3.translation: 下次咱们也许可以好好谈谈，而不是动手，对吧？

vsn:89183a9101c76e58.source: On the bright side, looks like some of my gear ended up in here.
vsn:89183a9101c76e58.translation: 往好处想，看来有些我的装备也掉进这里了。

vsn:a2246d750f54e739.source: Traveling through the stars... Documenting new types of fauna...
vsn:a2246d750f54e739.translation: 穿梭星海……记录新发现的动物种类……

vsn:afdba657b6312f6c.source: ...I knew that was a dangerous job filled with excitement and adventure
vsn:afdba657b6312f6c.translation: ……我早知道这是一份危险、又充满刺激与冒险的工作，

vsn:911229872faba84c.source: and that's what I was born to do!
vsn:911229872faba84c.translation: 而我生来就是干这个的！

vsn:aa3a15055176931b.source: On my very first mission to help solve a planet's eco-crisis!
vsn:aa3a15055176931b.translation: 第一次出任务，就要帮助解决一颗星球的生态危机！

vsn:9d76d38ac7c03d05.source: It's a huge responsibility, but this is what my training was all for.
vsn:9d76d38ac7c03d05.translation: 责任重大，但我接受训练，正是为了这一刻。

vsn:f44e9122f185821c.source: First step of the mission is to establish contact with the local fauna!
vsn:f44e9122f185821c.translation: 任务第一步，就是与当地动物建立联系！

vsn:0020e5b4ca5d8c56.source: ...and they didn't mean with my fists!

vsn:32c229ace0809d63.source: So now that I have you here, maybe you can help me out, whattayasay?
vsn:32c229ace0809d63.translation: 既然你就在这儿，也许能帮我点忙，你说呢？

vsn:0f774b4168ba79a2.source: If you know of any other strange agent-types that are down here could yo-
vsn:0f774b4168ba79a2.translation: 要是你知道这下面还有其他奇怪的特工模样的人，能不能——

vsn:20d9f535122454fd.source: I'm not gonna fight anymore! Come back here!!
vsn:20d9f535122454fd.translation: 我不会再动手了！回来啊！！

vsn:c0258d5bdbacd481.source: You're the only lead I have and... oh darn it!
vsn:c0258d5bdbacd481.translation: 你可是我唯一的线索，而且……哦，真可恶！

vsn:34d392f9f60e2cbc.source: But with all this roughhousing out of the way, how about we call a truce?
vsn:34d392f9f60e2cbc.translation: 不过既然已经打闹够了，不如我们休战吧？

vsn:46efcf4b1e51dde5.source: I'm down here to figure out what's keeping fellas like you from thriving
vsn:46efcf4b1e51dde5.translation: 我来这下面，就是要查清是什么让你们这样的家伙无法兴旺生存，

vsn:d93ae816a1ed32e4.source: so I know we'll work it out!
vsn:d93ae816a1ed32e4.translation: 所以我知道，我们一定能解决的！

vsn:79de9a041f5ad772.source: Trained in intergalactic standards of fauna management...
vsn:79de9a041f5ad772.translation: 受过星际动物管理标准的专业训练……

vsn:d0d634d77e1c566f.source: With our skills, we can turn around any planet, even a wasteland...
vsn:d0d634d77e1c566f.translation: 凭我们的本事，任何星球，哪怕是荒原，都能重获生机……

vsn:13d65128446f643c.source: Once we let our presence be known, on any planet of the galaxy...
vsn:13d65128446f643c.translation: 只要我们在银河中的任何星球亮明身份……

vsn:dc51f3640e743c5a.source: ...creatures just open up their hearts and souls to us!
vsn:dc51f3640e743c5a.translation: ……生物们就会向我们敞开心扉、坦诚相待！

vsn:a638941755971e4a.source: And with the combined efforts of all of us together, this planet will-
vsn:a638941755971e4a.translation: 而只要我们大家齐心协力，这颗星球就会——

vsn:36c41fd08c5bcfa9.source: I told you! We were on a truce now!
vsn:36c41fd08c5bcfa9.translation: 我说过了！我们现在已经休战了！

vsn:28b3262dad3c16fb.source: How'd ya like THOSE moves, buddy? Can't just launch yourself at a Cosmobreeder
vsn:28b3262dad3c16fb.translation: 伙计，这几招滋味如何？可不能对宇宙育种者扑过来，

vsn:930ad60a370bcd1f.source: and not end up on the receiving end of the PPP's renowned combat lessons!
vsn:930ad60a370bcd1f.translation: 却不领教一下PPP久负盛名的格斗课程！

vsn:bd204e16690efc47.source: Good thing you stopped when you did. One more counter from me and yo-
vsn:bd204e16690efc47.translation: 幸好你及时停手了。我要再反击一次，你就——

vsn:0a407dea450fa305.source: G-good to be back to my old self now but...
vsn:0a407dea450fa305.translation: 变、变回原来的自己真好，不过……

vsn:f74619ace6a0d8e0.source: ...yeah, t-that old dog can really fight... ouch...
vsn:f74619ace6a0d8e0.translation: ……是啊，那、那条老狗可真能打……疼……

vsn:52fc2899dc782058.source: ...or a place to fall asleep... ow...

vsn:dcb71450d6fd1cea.source: ...gee Dad, did you have to be so rough on that guy?
vsn:dcb71450d6fd1cea.translation: ……哎，爸爸，你非得对那个家伙下这么重的手吗？

vsn:10132d5bce4da119.source: My son, that "guy" was able to accept and master our ESPer powers
vsn:10132d5bce4da119.translation: 儿子，那个“家伙”竟能接受并掌握我们超能力者的力量，

vsn:bb03b965d6370a9e.source: He very well may be the one to save this world from the sorry state it's in.
vsn:bb03b965d6370a9e.translation: 他很可能就是能把这个世界从困境中拯救出来的人。

vsn:0537370f3998d8ee.source: Awww, look at you! You're adorable! And small!
vsn:0537370f3998d8ee.translation: 哎呀，瞧瞧你！真可爱！还这么小！

vsn:577b8185e573d308.source: What made you decide to start roughhousing with me, lil guy?
vsn:577b8185e573d308.translation: 小家伙，你怎么会想来跟我打闹呢？

vsn:8a9fdc2a45014e72.source: You're lucky that it was only me that you started tussling with
vsn:8a9fdc2a45014e72.translation: 算你走运，你惹上的只是我，

vsn:7c1b1ea37ea93a95.source: and not any of the more vicious creatures down here!
vsn:7c1b1ea37ea93a95.translation: 而不是这下面那些更凶狠的生物！

vsn:bf3b42d457a72a25.source: Some of them are pretty nasty, you know?
vsn:bf3b42d457a72a25.translation: 有些家伙可相当凶，你知道吗？

vsn:e0e5b8c4ac8e99df.source: Awww but you don't know what I'm going on about, do you?
vsn:e0e5b8c4ac8e99df.translation: 哎呀，不过你听不懂我在说什么，对吧？

vsn:f42a0b6c9ec66813.source: A cute little guy like you just wants to run and jump around...
vsn:f42a0b6c9ec66813.translation: 你这么可爱的小家伙，就该四处跑跑跳跳……

vsn:19d228fe8a1aa576.source: ...and that's what you should be allowed to do!
vsn:19d228fe8a1aa576.translation: ……而你就应该能自由自在地这么做！

vsn:30e8742790e28d40.source: Go on lil guy! Have more fun out there!
vsn:30e8742790e28d40.translation: 去吧，小家伙！到外面多玩玩！

vsn:a3965606eb2b94bd.source: Your big ol' uncle Yiffai will be around if you get into trouble
vsn:a3965606eb2b94bd.translation: 要是碰上麻烦，你的伊法伊大叔就在附近，

vsn:1b8c75a12753d2fe.source: so don't hesitate to bark out for help! I'll come a'runnin.
vsn:1b8c75a12753d2fe.translation: 尽管汪汪叫着求救！我会跑过来的。

vsn:9948367fd580ff6b.source: O-oh hey! That's some pretty mighty digging you're doing...
vsn:9948367fd580ff6b.translation: 哦、哦嘿！你挖得可真起劲……

vsn:930d9a0ee302cda9.source: Did you forget a bone or maybe a ball or something...
vsn:930d9a0ee302cda9.translation: 你是不是忘了骨头，或者球之类的什么东西……

vsn:5dad15f014379a7d.source: ...or is that a Level 1 Keycard? And you're giving it to me!?
vsn:5dad15f014379a7d.translation: ……还是说，那是张1级门卡？而你要把它送给我！？

vsn:dcf35c95a061612b.source: Well heck! Ain't you just the best little nephew Uncle Yiffai could want?
vsn:dcf35c95a061612b.translation: 哎呀！伊法伊大叔哪还能找到比你更棒的小侄子？

vsn:cd661f9207d19b5c.source: Thanks pupperoo, I won't forget it!
vsn:cd661f9207d19b5c.translation: 谢谢你，小狗崽，我不会忘记的！

vsn:6c8e6239472a2898.source: Oh come on, still worried because this is my first mission? I'll be on my toes!
vsn:6c8e6239472a2898.translation: 拜托，还因为这是我第一次出任务而担心？我会保持警惕的！

vsn:83e8a0ef1c62f059.source: Just remember, Tutone is having a mass exodus of fauna
vsn:83e8a0ef1c62f059.translation: 记住，图托恩正在发生动物大规模外逃，

vsn:a0bcd2b52f07a3b9.source: Don't they know that repairs and touch ups come out of my paycheck? The jerks...
vsn:a0bcd2b52f07a3b9.translation: 她们难道不知道维修和翻新都得从我的工资里扣？混蛋……

vsn:7a29004d181bed6f.source: That little punk just took my stuff and jumped down this hole!
vsn:7a29004d181bed6f.translation: 那个小混蛋抢了我的东西，跳进这个洞了！

vsn:90d984516674137c.source: The local fauna and the safety of my fellow agents is depending on me!
vsn:90d984516674137c.translation: 当地动物和特工同伴的安危，都指望我了！
